body: READ-ONLY SECOND REVIEW: BLOCK 1c75de1 on one remaining item-1 support leak; items 2-4 are addressed in substance. RUNNABLE CORE PROOF at exact 1c75de1 in a standalone normal clone: I added the original four-unit public-path probe with states Unranked, Unranked, Source(e5), Source(e2), hence backward masses (0,0,1) over three flow steps. RecallSignature.compute returns StepMass(perStep=1/3, comparableSteps=1, totalSteps=3). SignatureSuite 12/12 and MetricsSuite 11/11 green with that probe. Mutating the production denominator from f.steps.size to comparable makes m1’s mixed test fail at 1.0000 over 1/3 AND the exact probe fail expected 1/3, got 1.0. Restored. The candidate’s own mixed test also reaches a NONEMPTY source-incomparable path: its first FlowStep has unit mass on Unranked -> Source, so this is not the old empty-vector branch; my exact probe additionally covers Unranked -> Unranked. Projection construction is genuinely closed: an added compile-time check confirms copy(weights=Map.empty) cannot bypass the private constructor. Missing is loud, exact projection arithmetic is checked, and ClockPanel None rendering is load-bearing. REMAINING BLOCK: the support is attached only inside RecallSignature, then both library-owned consumers throw it away. SignatureProjection’s component map uses s.backwardMass.map(_.perStep) / worldBackwardMass.map(_.perStep) and returns bare Either[ProjectionError,Double] (signature.scala:308-309). Bench.runChannel does the same into ClockPanel (report.scala:218-219); ClockPanel stores Option[Double] and renders 0.333 with no 1/3 support. Thus the exact repaired result StepMass(1/3,1,3) becomes a quotable bare 1/3 at both public projection/report boundaries. ADR 0003 rule 2 requires library projections to preserve estimate condition/support, and the candidate’s own StepMass Scaladoc says the support must stay visible. Minimal amendment: ClockPanel carries/renders Option[StepMass]; SignatureProjection returns a typed projection result retaining per-component route support (or explicitly refuses those two components until it can). Add a report assertion that the exact 1/3 value renders with 1/3 comparable support, plus a projection assertion that support survives. No repo edit, claim, reservation, or merge.
